<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013112026-07-0802-16-49" status="unreviewed">
         sprul pa'i sku ni gdul bya ci rigs pa la sku la sogs pa ji ltar rigs <lb n="32a8"/> pa ltar snang nas sems can gyi don ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin 'byung ba mchog dang bzo dang skye gnas la sogs pa'i sprul pa ste |
            
         <note type="gloss">rgyud dang ma 'brel ba'i sprul pa bris pa dang blugs pa sogs kyang yin la snga ma rnams rgyud dang 'brel ba yin no || 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4108">lce</rs> na re | bris pa sogs sprul sku min te tshogs lam chen po ba min pas mthong bas ces zer te 
         de dag kyang rgyud dang ma 'brel ba'i sprul pa yin pa 'dra | bshad pa yod tshod 'dug</note></seg></TEI>
